title: Ban on Welcome from IPFS-sourced KPs unenforceable
description: SPEC l.1258, 1302 forbid Welcomes built from IPFS-sourced KeyPackages. A recipient cannot tell where the committer obtained the KP, so the rule is unenforceable as written. Fix: drop it, or restate as a committer-side SHOULD with no recipient check. Related to Q3 (agora-pozi.10). Line numbers refer to import/ files (notes/research-2026-10-16.md).
